grammar.summary: 本课学习被动语态与 must/ have to 的义务表达。

points.title: 被动语态（情感动作）
points.explanation: 被认为是：He is thought to be mad / Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad. 表状态和感受的被动叙事。

examples.en: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.

points.title: 情态表抗议
points.explanation: must be 表推测的否定：I can't be mad! 口语反问强化语气。

examples.en: I am one of the few people who live near an airport.
examples.cn: 我是少数住在机场附近的人之一。
